description: This file defines the Cart controller class for the checkout process in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It manages cart display, product addition, editing, removal, and JSON responses for cart data.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class for managing shopping cart operations in the checkout process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main cart page with all cart contents and layout components.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the cart contents and totals for display, handling errors and stock warnings.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Returns cart data in JSON format for AJAX requests.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart, validating options and subscriptions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a cart item.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart.
